# InkReel

> InkReel is a free Windows 10/11 (64-bit) app that turns video, photos and GIFs into pure black and white: every pixel is ink or paper, with dots, strokes and grain chosen by what is in the frame. / Безкоштовна програма для Windows, що перетворює відео, фото й GIF на чорно-біле.

- Five quality levels: Sketch, Outline, Halftone, Drawing, Engraving; "Symbols" mode (a picture made of letters); IRNM1, our own neural network.
- Export to MP4 (with sound) and GIF; the .ikr format renders once and exports without recomputing; 20 two-colour palettes.
- Free, no ads. Interface in Ukrainian and English. Apache-2.0 for the app's own code.
